description: One weekly PR per ecosystem for non-major updates, so bumps never pile up as one PR per package rewriting the same lockfile. Majors stay separate PRs. A 3-day soak matches the org's KMP preset, timestamp-optional as there, so digest and lockfile-maintenance updates, which carry no release timestamp, are not held forever. Vulnerability fixes skip the schedule and the soak. Minor, patch and digest updates and lockfile maintenance automerge through the merge queue once CI passes; majors and pins wait for review.

npm.description: Renovate's npm refuses to fetch @tailwindcss/oxide-wasm32-wasi (EALLOWREMOTE), so a full web-ui lock refresh always fails. The weekly web-ui group updates the lock only alongside a direct dependency bump, so transitive-only updates wait for one; re-enable this once the fetch works.

packageRules.description: Automerge non-major updates once CI passes, as the org's KMP preset does. Keep this rule first: packageRules apply in order and the last match wins. `pin` is left out because Renovate does not apply minimumReleaseAge to pin updates.
Keep the Docker image's Python within what ci.yml's test matrix covers (3.11 to 3.13); meshtastic itself requires <3.15. Raise this with the matrix.
Keep the workflows' setup-python version below 3.13: meshtasticd-native builds firmware with PlatformIO and SCons, which do not support newer Pythons, and PR CI never runs that job.
vite and its @vitejs plugins move together on a major; @vitejs/plugin-vue pins the vite majors it accepts.
